status: NO-GO current numerical stage; source-dependent fidelity remains pending
scope: Independent native donor-pair / preparation / comparative value source challenge; owner completes USZ/GSE221532 exact library-source mapping. No new expression or fidelity outcomes inspected.
favorable_evidence: Authentic native culture source origin is explicit for USZ20 and USZ22: corresponding native tumor STR authenticated, original tissues described.
Three public native culture RNA conditions remain eligible source context, not three matched independent donor systems.
A genuine paired, compatible malignant-cell transcriptional fidelity comparison could guide selection of model/handling context and may remain scientifically useful.
current_blockers: No compatible public same-donor native source-tumor and derived-culture RNA output pair authenticated in independently inspected methods. This is not denial of established physical native origin.
Brenca five FFPE/frozen pairs are preparation checks, not cultured derivatives; native12 and engineered11 must remain separate.
TempO12 are archival FFPE slide-scraped tissue, not culture samples; fixed-probe capture, unknown purity and source donor overlap do not establish tumor-cell intrinsic fidelity.
Public culture RNA and unrelated TCGA/tissue cohorts cannot identify whether a culture retains its own donor-specific transcriptional identity.
Handling, passage, culture selection, bulk stroma/immune mixture and assay platform differences can dominate expression distance.
prior_art_and_value: Published origin/authentication, fusion/morphology and frozen/FFPE concordance are established findings. A generic bulk-versus-culture shift or old panel rescore would not add a consequential model-fidelity result. Novel useful donor-specific fidelity remains conditional on the source/control gates, not disproven by missing data.

prospective_reopening.needed: Explicit same-donor RNA libraries/outputs for original native tumor and derived culture with full passage/media/preparation/capture/mixture/control map; independent donor systems and suitable unmatched native donor/handling controls.
prospective_reopening.all_conditions: All eligible native pairs, serial cultures, passages, tissue regions, technical replicates and controls retained; no gene/feature selection from favorable values or old failed panels.
prospective_reopening.future_stage: Before any new numerical outcomes, dated source-specific protocol and root review selecting compatible features, normalization, donor comparisons, uncertainty and disproof. >=2 independent native donor systems for a general fidelity claim; n1 can only support a bounded source-specific description if useful.
prospective_reopening.disproof: Pair/capture identity unsupported; composition/platform/history dominates or cannot be constrained; original prior art already answers the claim; no practical model or measurement decision beyond expected admixture or generic fidelity visualization.

coverage_limit: Methods of selected actual sources and verified prior condition inventories evaluated. Full all-public donor/culture output coverage is not completed; unresolved eligible source maps and unavailable original outputs remain pending and block promotion. No global dataset absence, biological model failure or search exhaustion.
exposure: No new gene measurements or paired fidelity outcomes inspected. Previously evaluated R8 DLL3/SEZ6/NCAM1 panel values were initially displayed in a metadata-named file and excluded from feature choice/analysis; no full old-source numeric blinding claimed.
restriction_scope: Selected allowed culture identity, preparation, authentication and RNA assay methods only; no denied structural-genomic mechanisms, FAP-tissue/glycan/HLA science or shelved TMEM266/panel/IR/APA reanalysis.
